# T16 — Closure review (record completed, 2026-11-23)

Project: T16 — SOP, RDF/OWL and process-document ingestion · Tranche 4 · Plan: SPEC_V2 §12 · Issues #85, #448

## Outcome vs acceptance

SPEC_V2 §12 T16's gate is met by executed tests at lane head `46fc49e2`, not by prose: a real SOP, an OWL
file and a BPMN diagram each ingest end to end (`a_pdf_sop_becomes_a_pddl_procedure_draft`,
`an_owl_file_becomes_a_knowledge_pack`, `a_bpmn_diagram_becomes_a_procedure_draft`); the draft is published
behind a human gate while the drafting job cannot publish its own procedure
(`a_human_approval_publishes_the_procedure`, `the_drafting_job_cannot_publish_its_own_procedure`); a re-ingest
creates the next draft version while the published row keeps its source and pack
(`a_reingest_creates_a_new_draft_version`, `the_published_procedure_keeps_its_source_and_pack`); a bound job
runs the PDDL steps and an unreviewed source never binds (`a_bound_job_runs_the_pddl_steps`,
`an_unreviewed_source_cannot_bind`). 25 tests, 25 passed, 0 skipped.

## Evidence

The published acceptance evidence `01a20a8d-73fb-74f6-849a-d0fb1a535179` carries the command and the clause-to-test map; the
delivery contract is live with its Board decision and the Phase-G review is compliant and cites the
published standing delegation `01a1fb9f-ac2d-732d-b274-1079be3dd2b3`. The manifest `acceptance/programme/T16.toml` executed against
this record is the gate.

## Open items

None owned by T16. The tranche-4 review and the programme-level benefits are recorded separately.

## Decision

Close.
